mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies near Badger Ridge Middle School and a beautiful Full Moon lighting up the night.
The city has a new road treatment schedule starting August 4th on Lincoln Street, and don't forget the city manages the Verona Cemetery where plot applications are now available.
Today you can enjoy live music at Bailey's Run, and tomorrow the Sugar River Paddle and Jamboree and the Remote Area Medical clinic take place at Verona Area High School.
In a noteworthy update from last week, a 55-year-old woman was arrested for an O W I on July 26th after officers clocked her driving 97 miles per hour.
Today's flavor is the delightful Raspberry Cheesecake. Since they are currently closed, stop by when they open at 10 AM to grab a scoop.
